category_edits.rationale: Test a small increase in training-frequency input modulation from 0.02 to 0.025 across all four datasets. Existing checkpoints retain the feature scales, and the predictor loads that buffer unchanged. Preserve embeddings, backbone, readout, loss, optimizer and one model per category.

change_summary: Increase training-only frequency feature amplitude to 0.025 for all four BERT4Rec category models.
